items.title: Starbucks Will Close 250 More Cafes as Part of CEO Niccol’s Turnaround Plan
items.summary: Starbucks  announced another round of closures for locations across the U.S. and Canada on Thursday.  The company cited CEO Brian Niccol’s yearslong strategy to revive its brand and boost profitability.  Chief Operating Officer Mike Grams said Starbucks will close about 250 cafes in North America, representing about 1% of its 18,000 locations.

items.title: Starbucks Plans to Close 250 North America Stores and Record $300 Million Charge
items.summary: Starbucks (NASDAQ:SBUX) plans to close 250 underperforming stores in North America and expects to record approximately $300 million in restructuring charges related to the move, according to a regulatory filing. The planned closures represent about 1% of Starbucks’ approximately 18,000 locations across North America.

items.title: Starbucks Says It’s Closing 250 Stores Across North America This Week
items.summary: Some Americans might soon have to drive a bit further to get their favorite coffee, as Starbucks is closing hundreds of stores.
